summary: Imported personal-notes SPL query from the "Splunkdbconnectmailmarshalintegrationdatabasequeriesusingpowershell" topic.

spl:
$connection = new-object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection
$datasource = " SQL SERVER "
$database = "MailMarshal"
$connectionstring = "Server=$datasource;Database=$database;Integrated Security=SSPI;"
$connection.connectionstring=$connectionstring
$connection.open()
$query = @"
SELECT [Message].[TimeLogged]
      ,[Message].[BlockNumber]
      ,[Message].[BlockRecipientIndex]
      ,[Message].[MessageName]
      ,[Message].[ServerId]
      ,[Message].[MessageSize]
      ,[Message].[Subject]
      ,[Message].[TimeArrived]
      ,[Message].[FromUser]
      ,[Message].[FromDomain]
      ,[Message].[FromLocal]
      ,[Message].[Edition]
      ,[Message].[ActionType]
      ,[Message].[Classification]
      ,[Message].[Description]
      ,[Message].[RecipientUser]
      ,[Message].[RecipientDomain]
      ,[Message].[RecipientLocal]
      ,[Message].[FolderID]
      ,[Message].[Deleted]
      ,[Message].[SessionNumber]
      ,[Message].[BytesSent]
      ,[Message].[FirstInBlock]
      ,[Message].[ParentEdition]
      ,[Message].[HasAttachments]
	  ,[Content].[AttachmentId]
	  ,[Content].[ParentAttachmentId]
	  ,[Content].[FileType]
	  ,[Content].[FileName]
	  ,[Content].[FileSize]
      ,[Message].[IsTerminal]
      ,[Message].[MessageBody]
      ,[Message].[SpamCensorType]
      ,[Message].[RuleName]
  FROM [MailMarshal].[dbo].[Message]
	  ,[MailMarshal].[dbo].[Content]
WHERE [Content].[MessageName] = [Message].[MessageName]
"@
$command=$connection.createCommand()
$command.commandtext=$query
$result = $command.ExecuteReader()
$table = new-object "System.Data.Datatable"
$table.Load($result)
$output=$table|select filetype,fromdomain |sort-object -property fromdomain|group-object filetype,fromdomain
$output|foreach{
    $properties = @{
        'FromDomain' = ($_.name -split ", ")[1]
        'FileType' = ($_.name -split ", ")[0]
        'Count' = $_.count
    }
    $psobject = new-object psobject -property $properties
    $csv += $psobject
}
$command.EndExecuteReader()
$csv|export-csv c:\perflogs\export.csv
